description: This file contains PHPUnit test class `AttendanceConfigurationAPITest` for testing the `AttendanceConfigurationAPI` class in the OrangeHRM attendance API module. It includes test methods for 'getOne', 'update', 'delete', and validation rules, as well as data providers for parameterized tests.
